newsitem.title: UK: Shalibane shares make strong AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: Shalibane shares make strong AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in Shalibane Plc, a producer of specialised engineering products for the European car industry, made a strong market debut on Friday on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
The shares were marked up at 137.5p by 1414 GMT from the placing price of 125p, which had given Shalibane a market capitalisation of 6.01 million stg.
"The share price opened strongly. The placing went very well and very smoothly," said a company spokesman.
The placing, with Rowan Dartington as broker and Brown Shipley as adviser, raised a net 2.7 million stg.
Shalibane will use the proceeds to reduce borrowing and increase working capital in order to fund an expected increase in turnover and new product development.
